v0.14 development gate
----------------------
Deterministic counterfactual / sensitivity evaluation adds:
- Alchemy-managed LegalCounterfactualEvaluator;
- pure LegalCounterfactualAssumption / Comparison / Set values;
- CONTEXT scope for pre-existing world facts and ACTION_OVERRIDE scope for facts created/changed by the proposal;
- explicit reuse of the ordinary LegalEffectEngine over the same sealed generation and cloned inputs;
- hypothetical=true / authoritative=false boundary on all counterfactual results;
- COUNTERFACTUAL_ASSUMPTION fact authority retained in alternate decision traces;
- deterministic status/disposition/controlling-norm/conflict/source-anchor deltas;
- deterministic counterfactualIdentity and setIdentity;
- evaluateBoolean() which executes both FALSE and TRUE branches instead of inferring a flip from reviewInputs().

Important invariants
--------------------
- Counterfactual evaluation never mutates the original LegalEffectAssessment, LegalAction, LegalContext or decision trace.
- CONTEXT assumptions modify only a cloned current-world fact set before the original action is evaluated.
- ACTION_OVERRIDE assumptions are appended only to a copied action and therefore can override a proposed-action fact without altering the original action.
- Every assumed fact is labelled COUNTERFACTUAL_ASSUMPTION; a hypothetical value is not source evidence.
- Counterfactual results are explicitly hypothetical and non-authoritative and cannot substitute for source authority, compilation certification or a Runtime Registry legal lease.
- Alternate status/applicability/conflicts are produced by the ordinary LegalEffectEngine; the trace/query layer does not predict them.
- A same-value assumption may produce a different trace because the hypothesis is visible, but legallyMaterial remains false when status/dispositions/control/conflicts/source closure are unchanged.
- evaluateBoolean() actually executes two branches; it does not treat an UNKNOWN review input as proof of either outcome.
- legal semantic identity, runtime identity, compiler/source-authority identity, traceIdentity, queryIdentity and counterfactualIdentity remain separate claims.

Packaging
---------
Packaging is manual for this cut, per current project workflow. MANIFEST.sha256 is regenerated before each archive and verified after clean extraction.

Candidate artifact acceptance
-----------------------------
Candidate clean extraction manifest: 46/46 PASS.
All 474 explicit assertions reproduced from the candidate extraction. Structured Relation, HardWorld, Runtime Registry live bridge and deterministic bundle also passed. A cumulative crypto-heavy integration batch reached its wall-clock ceiling while inside the Runtime Registry evidence chain after the preceding crypto gates had passed; no assertion failure was reported. The runtime-evidence chain, HardWorld promotion, seven demos and 8/8 class compilation were then rerun independently from the same clean candidate extraction and all passed.

Final artifact acceptance
-------------------------
The package is rebuilt after this evidence is recorded. MANIFEST.sha256 and key gates are rechecked from the exact final ZIP before release.
